tokens.name: marigold-100
tokens.usage: Tint ground for marigold callouts, selected filter chips and the Gold tier badge fill.

tokens.name: marigold-300
tokens.usage: Ornament strokes and decorative dividers. Not for text or small icons.

tokens.name: marigold-500
tokens.usage: The Marry Me brand hue. Primary button fill, active nav underline, the garland motif.

tokens.name: marigold-700
tokens.usage: Marigold text and icons on a light ground, and primary-button hover fill.

tokens.name: rani-100
tokens.usage: Tint ground for the RSVP panel and the Platinum tier badge.

tokens.name: rani-300
tokens.usage: Decorative rule and floral-motif strokes in the invitation layer.

tokens.name: rani-500
tokens.usage: Accent hue. Secondary CTA fill, price figures, the heart and mandala marks.

tokens.name: rani-700
tokens.usage: Rani text and icons on a light ground, and secondary-button hover fill.

tokens.name: peacock-100
tokens.usage: Tint ground for informational notes and the Silver tier badge.

tokens.name: peacock-300
tokens.usage: Ornament strokes where marigold would clash with a warm photograph.

tokens.name: peacock-500
tokens.usage: Third festive hue. Countdown digits, link underlines, the peacock-feather motif.

tokens.name: peacock-700
tokens.usage: Peacock text and icons on a light ground. Passes 4.5:1 on surface-page.

tokens.name: mehendi-100
tokens.usage: Tint ground for the attending badge on a wish card.

tokens.name: mehendi-500
tokens.usage: Fourth festive hue. Leaf and vine ornament, the mehendi-ceremony event marker.

tokens.name: mehendi-700
tokens.usage: Mehendi text on a light ground.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: The page ground. Set on body. Warm cream in Day, plum-black in Night.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and popovers that sit above the page.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed wells: the filter bar, table stripes, an inactive tab strip.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Footer, dark banners and toasts. Pair with ink-on-inverse.

tokens.name: surface-brand
tokens.usage: Primary button and brand-filled surfaces. Pair with ink-on-brand.

tokens.name: surface-accent
tokens.usage: Secondary button and accent-filled surfaces. Pair with ink-on-accent.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Headings and any text that must carry the page. A plum-biased ink, never pure black.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Running body copy and paragraph text.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, timestamps, helper text under a field. Never below 12px.

tokens.name: ink-on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-brand. Marigold is a light hue, so this stays dark in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-accent.

tokens.name: ink-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between list rows and card sections.

tokens.name: line-firm
tokens.usage: Input borders, card outlines and anything the eye must find.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px keyboard focus ring, offset 2px. Clears 3:1 on every surface token.

tokens.name: signal-success
tokens.usage: RSVP accepted, invite delivered, payment cleared.

tokens.name: signal-warning
tokens.usage: Rush-delivery windows and approaching RSVP cut-offs.

tokens.name: signal-danger
tokens.usage: Validation errors and RSVP declines. Never used decoratively.

tokens.name: signal-info
tokens.usage: Neutral informational notes. Distinct from the peacock accent by role, not hue.

tokens.name: invite-ground
tokens.usage: Invitation layer: the base ground of an invite section. Overridden per template theme.

tokens.name: invite-ground-alt
tokens.usage: Invitation layer: the alternating band ground, so adjacent sections separate without borders.

tokens.name: invite-ink
tokens.usage: Invitation layer: couple names, event titles, all primary invite text.

tokens.name: invite-ink-soft
tokens.usage: Invitation layer: parent names, venue lines, the RSVP-by date.

tokens.name: invite-primary
tokens.usage: Invitation layer: the template's hero hue. Every template theme overrides this.

tokens.name: invite-secondary
tokens.usage: Invitation layer: the template's second hue, for accents and the gate monogram.

tokens.name: invite-tertiary
tokens.usage: Invitation layer: the template's third hue, for countdown digits and dot indicators.

tokens.name: invite-metal
tokens.usage: Invitation layer: foil rules, monogram strokes and the gate frame. One metal per template.

tokens.name: invite-ornament
tokens.usage: Invitation layer: half-strength ornament for repeated motifs that must sit behind text.

tokens.name: invite-veil
tokens.usage: Invitation layer: the scrim laid over a photograph so invite-ink on top stays at 4.5:1.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: One per page. The marketing hero line only.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Section openers on the marketing site.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Card group headings and modal titles.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Template card titles and pricing plan names.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs directly under a display heading.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default running text. Keep the measure near 65 characters.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense lists, feature rows, table cells.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, eyebrows and tier badges. Apply text-transform: uppercase in CSS.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Helper text, timestamps, the fine print under a price.

styles.name: action
styles.usage: Button and link labels. Pair with ink-on-brand or ink-on-accent.

styles.name: festive-xl
styles.usage: Devanagari and Gujarati headings. Baloo 2 carries both scripts.

styles.name: festive-md
styles.usage: Indic event names and ceremony labels inside an invite.

styles.name: festive-sm
styles.usage: Indic body text. Latin body text stays on the sans family.

styles.name: invite-names
styles.usage: The couple's names on the hero. The single largest thing in the product.

styles.name: invite-title
styles.usage: Invite section titles: Wedding Events, Our Gallery, Guest RSVP.

styles.name: invite-eyebrow
styles.usage: The small tracked line above an invite section title. Always uppercase.

styles.name: invite-body
styles.usage: Invite prose: the story timeline, the thank-you note, venue detail.

spacing.note: A 4px base grid. Steps 1 to 6 are component-internal; 8 and up separate blocks and sections.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Badge padding, chip gaps, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input padding and list-row gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default card padding and the page side gutter. Never go below this at the screen edge.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding and card gaps in a grid.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Generous card padding and the gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading and its content block.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between sibling blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on tablets.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Gap between major marketing sections.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Invitation section rhythm, where scroll pacing matters more than density.

radius.note: Festive means round. The scale runs generous on purpose, and radius-arch is composed, not a token.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags, the inner edge of a swatch, a progress bar.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects and textareas.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Standard cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Template cards, plan cards and the RSVP panel.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero media, the gate screen frame and full-bleed photo blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, filter chips, tier badges and the floating music control.

shadow.note: Elevation is warm, never neutral grey. Each shadow is tinted with the plum ink so it reads as light through fabric.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting state of a chip or a small control.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Cards at rest and the sticky header once the page has scrolled.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Hovered template cards, modals and the gate screen.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: The one marigold glow, reserved for the primary CTA on hover.

zIndex.note: An invite page layers parallax art, sticky chrome and a full-screen gate, so stacking is a token, not a guess.

tokens.name: z-base
tokens.usage: Section backgrounds and parallax art beds.

tokens.name: z-ornament
tokens.usage: Decorative motifs that float over the background but under text.

tokens.name: z-content
tokens.usage: All readable content. Text never sits below this.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: The sticky site header and the invite section-progress rail.

tokens.name: z-control
tokens.usage: The floating music toggle and the WhatsApp order button.

tokens.name: z-gate
tokens.usage: The full-screen gate and its opening animation.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the gallery lightbox and toasts. Nothing goes above this.
